title: Origin story: Robin Hood
description: Robin Hood was the yeoman outlaw of Sherwood Forest, who with Little John, Friar Tuck, Will Scarlet, and his merry men robbed the rich to feed the poor under the cruel Sheriff of Nottingham and Prince John. The earliest ballads show a trickster yeoman; later tales made him the dispossessed Earl of Huntingdon.
